name: test-model-deepseekr1-mtp-ep
author: ModelTC
description: Runs LightLLM DeepSeek-R1 EP MoE + MTP (EAGLE) server variants and GSM8K lm_eval against localhost. Requires each full run to use a dedicated log directory: persist every api_server process log under that tree (per-variant subdirectories recommended), write the consolidated summary to summary.txt in that same log directory, and keep artifacts separated from other test runs. Use when running DeepSeek-R1 MTP EP accuracy workflows or when the user asks to run these four server configurations one-by-one with logged results.
